profile_text.body:
Ollama is a company founded in 2023 that provides tooling for running open-source large language models, either locally on a user's own hardware or through a cloud service. The company describes itself as offering the easiest way to automate work using open models while keeping data private. Its cloud offering hosts models in the US, Europe, and Singapore, and the company states that user data is never used for training by any provider. Local model usage is always free, with cloud tiers available on an upgrade basis with no stated hidden limits.

The core product, also called Ollama, is categorized as an open-source and self-hosted model runner. It allows users to run large language models locally without data leaving their environment, which the site positions as combining the privacy of local deployment with optional cloud capacity for higher throughput when running multiple agents simultaneously. The held facts note that model supply-chain verification is a consideration for users of the platform.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for Ollama.
